cim_eredeti: V7 cuts costs 78% while boosting accuracy with GPT‑5.6 Luna
szoveg_eredeti:
V7 Go organizes company files into a Context Graph that agents can query to screen investment deals and support insurance underwriting. On V7’s hardest graph-query tests across thousands of documents, GPT-6 Astra reached 89% accuracy.

Read the full story: https://openai.com/index/v7/
